purpose: Local Docker functional check of the new playback-history default (no env) and of the rollback via env: an in-container config check of the effective setting, then one H1 range-series run per setting in the gsp03-v1 rtt1/dbload cell (gsp03-v1 plan, 256 MiB, 20 Range GETs, parallel SQLite write load). n = 1 per setting: latencies are descriptive, not a comparison.
